name: reflex-xy
description: Create Python XY charts inside the desktop conversation, with local controls and Colorset 1 by default.

interface.longDescription: Generate Python XY charts from supplied data. Display charts in the conversation through MCP Apps. Palette changes, view controls and downloads run locally without requesting another model turn. Colorset 1 is the default; Colorset 2 is optional.
defaultPrompt: Chart my supplied data using Colorset 1
